description: What the webview is allowed to ask the shell for: read the state the supervisor publishes, and check for, install and restart into a signed update (the feed is `plugins.updater.endpoints`). Opening a page of the site is the shell's own `open_on_site` command, which builds the URL itself (`src/site.rs`). The top bar moves the window and maximizes it on a double click (`data-tauri-drag-region`), the title bar being drawn over by it on macOS.
